contributorPath.before: Changing a model/thinking/rename transport required following controls.api(owner), an ignored-host closure, createSessionApi's factory-local mutate and a factory mutation method. Every dispatch allocated the entire factory even though only one method was used.
contributorPath.after: Controls validates/refreshes its captured endpoint, then calls the named API operation with request/endpoint/id/value. API owns wire serialization and response decoding; controls alone owns selection/generation/order/patch policy. No new facade or duplicate policy owner.
